description: Given a LinkedIn post URL or id, return the companies whose people engaged (reacted/commented), ranked by engager count. Joins through person_positions(is_current=true). Pure DB read — no LinkedIn pull, no credits charged. Engagers without a known current company are bucketed as `_unknown_company`. Optional industry_urn filter narrows to one industry.

post_id.description: posts.id UUID (use when you already know the local id)

top_engagers_per_company.description: How many sample engager names to attach per company row (0-10, default 3)

name: get_post_engagers_by_company
title: Engagers Grouped by Company
